text:
Search and manage a Qdrant vector store without holding its key. Call the Qdrant API within your read, write or admin role. Start with request GET /collections.
[destructive] request <verb> <path> [body...]: Call the Qdrant API and get its JSON answer. Calls run as write by default; ask for read explicitly, and admin is needed for collection and service changes.
  verb (GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS): Case-sensitive HTTP method
  path (string): API path and optional encoded query, starting with /
  body (string): Raw JSON bytes; no body for GET, HEAD or OPTIONS

Examples
agent-bus call '#qdrant@node.example' 'request GET /collections'
